description: This file defines a React component 'ViewDetailsModal' that displays a modal dialog with detailed information about a JSON data object. It includes utility functions for formatting labels and currency, handles special rendering for specific cost-related keys, and showcases how to present arbitrary JSON data in a user-friendly way.

methods.name: ViewDetailsModal
methods.description: React functional component rendering a modal that displays details for a given data object. It formats labels, handles rendering of various data types, and provides special formatting for cost-related fields.

methods.name: isUserCostKeyLoose

methods.description: Converts a value to a number using parseUsdToNumber utility.

methods.description: Renders a value appropriately based on its type, with special handling for user cost keys.
